newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippine rebel firing squad executes two killers.
newsitem.headline: Philippine rebel firing squad executes two killers.

text.p: A Moslem rebel firing squad wearing ski masks executed two alleged murderers in the southern Philippines before hundreds of villagers, including children, rebel and police officials said on Wednesday.
They said the squad -- 11 masked guerrillas armed with assault rifles -- carried out the executions on Monday on Nosa-nosa island in nearby Lanao del Sur province.

The two men, both Moslems, had been found guilty of a series of murders by a panel of Islamic religious leaders, Moro Islamic Liberation Front (MILF) commander Jianati Mimbatas said by telephone from his provincial headquarters.

The executions were confirmed by police sergeant Mayaman Anguintaupan and by local Moslem leader Abdullah Lacs Dalidig. The police sergeant said he had received an official report on the executions and Dalidig said he was among 600 people who witnessed the shootings.
Dalidig told reporters a survey of residents of Lanao del Sur showed "overwhelming approval of the just and speedy trial undertaken by the MILF".
The MILF has been fighting for an Islamic state on the southern Mindanao island and is now engaged in peace talks with Manila.
